label: The Trade Desk
terms_note: The Platform API is available to The Trade Desk partner seats; the API credentials come from your Account Manager and API tokens (one week to one year) are generated in the OpenTTD Access Management app (https://open.thetradedesk.com/advertiser/docsApp/Foundations/resources/doc/PlatformAuthentication, read 2026-09-25).

discovery.auth: token (TTD-Auth header: long-lived API token generated in the Partner Portal, or session token from /v3/authentication)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (The Trade Desk Platform API v3).
auth: 1. Log in to the Partner Portal with seat credentials; **Manage API tokens** → Generate Token (name + lifespan; the value is shown once; revoke any time).
2. Send `TTD-Auth: <token>` on every request (alternatively `POST /v3/authentication` with login + password returns a session token).

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: Platform API token generated in OpenTTD > Access Management > Generate Token / Key (Application: Platform API; lifetime one week to one year), sent as the TTD-Auth header. Short-lived tokens from POST /v3/authentication also work until they expire.

config_fields.name: partner_id
config_fields.help: Your Partner ID (e.g. from POST /v3/partner/query); list_accounts lists the advertisers of this partner (POST /v3/advertiser/query/partner needs PartnerId).

me.note: POST /v3/partner/query {PageStartIndex: 0, PageSize: 1}: 'Get all Partners that are accessible' to the token; account.Result[0].PartnerId is the partner id to configure.

list_accounts.note: POST /v3/advertiser/query/partner {PartnerId (config partner_id), PageStartIndex: 0, PageSize: 100}: 'Get Advertisers that belong to the specified Partner' (first 100). The advertiser id is the account_id for list_campaigns.

list_campaigns.note: POST /v3/campaign/query/advertiser {AdvertiserId, PageStartIndex (zero-based offset), PageSize, Availabilities}: 'Get a page of Campaigns that belong to the specified Advertiser'. `status` is an Availability (Available or Archived). `budget` is the campaign's total Budget (Money {Amount, CurrencyCode}); DailyBudget, PacingMode and CampaignFlights are in raw.

update_budget.note: PUT /v3/campaign {CampaignId, DailyBudget: {Amount, CurrencyCode}} ('Update an existing campaign'). DailyBudget is Money: Amount is a decimal in the advertiser's currency and CurrencyCode (e.g. USD) is REQUIRED, so pass `currency`. TTD: 'For campaigns with multiple flights, this property becomes read-only and its value is determined by individual flight budget values' - such campaigns are rejected; change the flight budget in the platform instead.

not_offered.get_report: Date-ranged performance metrics are served by the GraphQL API ('generalReporting(where: { date: { gte: "2025-02-01", lt: "2025-03-01" } })', https://open.thetradedesk.com/advertiser/docsApp/GuidesAdvertiser/api/doc/AdvertiserGQLQueryExamples) whose selection-set braces the adapter's string templates cannot build, or by asynchronous My Reports schedules; the only REST metrics call, GET /v3/campaign/{campaignId}/metrics, returns 'Metrics and goals over the 4 week span' and cannot honour date_from/date_to.
not_offered.pause_resume: Campaigns have no paused state in the Platform API: Availability is only 'Available' or 'Archived' and 'Once a campaign is updated to `Archived`, it cannot be set back to `Available`' (PUT /v3/campaign, https://open.thetradedesk.com/advertiser/docsApp/AdvertiserReferences/api/ref/put-campaign); delivery is switched on and off per ad group (isEnabled), which the campaign-level verb cannot address.
